messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning to pin Olive-3B-v2 into catalog slot 42 tomorrow at 09:30 PT. DRI for the rollout is @Liam. Need a short smoke checklist + rollback command so ops can be on standby.
Liam: Got it. I can own the deploy and smoke. Will be around. What’s the canary traffic split? :eyes:
Maya: Start with 2% for 10m, then 20% for 15m, then full if no regressions. Keep a fast rollback plan though.
Sophia: Re: evaluations — the eval run for q/a and safety passed, but we saw a slight regression on coherence metric vs prior v1. Benign for chat use but flagging.
Noah: On infra, make sure the dedicated pool has quantized kernels ready; we had a slow cold-start on a previous quant build.
Liam: OK. Smoke checklist draft:
- Deploy to staging slot 42 (pin alias -> olive-3b-v2)
- Run 3 short inference tests (latency + correctness)
- Checkconsole: per-token latency < 95th pct SLAs
- Verify model metrics dashboard (QA set) — no >3% drop in quality
- Canary ramp as Maya said
- Rollback: repoint alias to olive-3b-v1 and scale down v2
Snippets for smoke (copy for ops):
```bash
# smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"olive-3b-v2","input":"Summarize: Redwood inference platform","max_tokens":20}' | jq .
```
Liam: Rollback command (ops playbook):
```bash
# rollback alias
./cli catalog alias swap --slot 42 --from olive-3b-v2 --to olive-3b-v1 --reason "rollback: regressions"
# scale down new variant
kubectl -n inference scale deployment olive-3b-v2 --replicas=0
```
Rohan: Will add an ops runbook note and set a monitoring alert for endpoint error_rate > 0.5% and avg latency increase > 40%.
eng-bot: Deploy scheduled by @Liam for 2026-03-19T09:30:00-07:00 (canary 2% -> 20% -> 100%).
Sophia: Quick CR ping @Liam — there’s a small doc tweak in the model metadata (license field) I pushed to PR. If we merge after 08:30 PT we’re good.
Liam: Reviewing now. If PR looks good I’ll merge by 08:45 so CI has time before the 09:30 window.
Noah: I'll watch infra warmups and KV cache priming — will prefetch common prompts to avoid first-token spikes.
Maya: Thanks all. Post-deploy, let's reconvene in #eng-ml in 30m after final ramp. If anyone needs to opt out of canary, speak now. :thumbsup:
Liam: All set. I'll attach smoke outputs here after staging run.
Liam: Staging smoke run (09:00 PT) — latency ok, small coherence diff shown in logs:
```
{"request_id":"r_123","latency_ms":210,"tokens":18,"status":"ok"}
{"eval": "coherence_delta", "value": -0.028}
```
Liam: Based on this, proceed with the canary. Will watch quality dashboards and keep rollback ready.
Maya: Launching 2% canary at 09:30. Ops on standby. Thanks team. »
